fields.Name: T193 - Admin ERD Layout Algorithm Toggle
fields.Description: Exercises the ERD layout-engine switch (setLayoutAlgorithm 'schema-grid' vs 'dagre') that recomputes node coordinates — a code path with no analog in grid/form tests.

InputDefinition.goal: In MJ Explorer, switch to the Admin application via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo. Open 'Data & Schema' and open the ERD (Entity Relationship Diagram) viewer. Wait for the diagram to render (10-30s possible in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away). The diagram header has a layout-mode toggle group with two buttons: a 'Schema grid' layout (table-cells icon) and a 'Hierarchical' layout (sitemap icon). Note the current arrangement of entity cards, then click the OTHER layout button. Success is that the diagram re-lays-out the entity cards in response — the node positions visibly rearrange and the newly-clicked layout button shows an active/selected state. Seeing the relayout is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: The ERD renders with a layout toggle offering Schema-grid and Hierarchical modes
Clicking the alternate layout button visibly rearranges the entity-card positions and marks that button active
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
